measurement.method: continuous segment distance with adaptive curve Hausdorff bounds
measurement.nearestPoints: points on the bounded polyline approximation; exact for original straight segments
measurement.connections: shared original drawn endpoints or exact original straight intersections only; never ink contact
measurement.scope: disconnected centerline components, not spacing inside a connected component

spacing.reason: All disconnected components meet the required spacing.

rules.centerline_measurement: sampled distance to union of bounded-error chords

profile.semantic_use: container noun, or a container hosting a sub icon

circle_hole_exception.scope: Complete circular contours only; hole gate only. Spacing, pinch and other checks still apply.

internal_parallel_straight.measurement: midpoint normals, nearest each side, with overlap fallback
internal_parallel_straight.merge: touching collinear pieces in same path

internal_spacing.notice: Sampled opposing-edge review; unresolved findings prevent publication. Ordinary joins and complete circular contours are excluded. Negative gap indicates overlapping ink.
